title: GTA 6 Has a Streamer in the Trunk 😭
youtube_title: GTA 6 Has a Streamer in the Trunk 😭
youtube_description:
GTA 6 has a streamer in the trunk. In Rockstar's An Extended Look (at 18:12), a woman opens a car's trunk and there's a guy lying inside with his phone. He films himself and even asks his chat what to do ("chat, what do I do?"), and when the cops chase them, the screen shows his livestream: LIVE 51k, then LIVE 53k, a chat ("dayum", "Bro loves attention lol", "KING OF TRUNK!!!", "That's tuff", "first stream!!!") and a View Livestream button prompt. Rockstar says the Extended Look was captured entirely from in-game footage on the PlayStation 5.

Would you watch his livestream? Yes or no?

Sources (Rockstar Games, read Nov 24, 2026):
- Grand Theft Auto VI: An Extended Look, August 27, 2026, 18:12 to 18:28 ("Captured entirely from in-game footage on the PlayStation 5"): https://www.rockstargames.com/VI/an-extended-look
- Grand Theft Auto VI, out November 19, 2026: https://www.rockstargames.com/VI

The stream overlay, the wanted stars, the car chase picture and the chat lines in this Short are our own redraw of what the Extended Look shows on screen (the handles are left off). About 51,000 and about 53,000 are our reading of 51k and 53k. We don't know yet what the View Livestream button does or who the streamer is.

Trailer clips: Rockstar Games (GTA VI: An Extended Look), used for commentary. Not affiliated with Rockstar Games or Take-Two.
